description.zh: 背景图作为参考素材锁住场景，人物在固定机位口播，预览面板设为循环播放，适合反复看口型和节奏。现在带的是占位背景。
description.en: The backdrop image is used as a reference to lock the scene; the presenter stays in a fixed shot. Preview loops so you can judge lip-sync and pacing.

why.zh: 参考图决定场景。留着占位背景跑，背景会是一片网格，跟你想要的环境无关。
why.en: The reference image defines the scene. With the placeholder you get a grid, not your room.

placeholder.zh: 例：一位女性主持人正面讲解产品用法
placeholder.en: e.g. a presenter explains the product to camera
